behavior: Dependencies and tools are on their latest versions: npm packages, pnpm, Go modules and toolchain, forge-std, Foundry in CI and the CI actions
acceptance: Every npm package in the workspace is on its latest version except @axe-core/playwright, held at 4.13.0 (pnpm outdated -r lists only it); pnpm is 12.15.0
Every direct Go module is on its latest version (go list -m -u lists no direct update), the Go toolchain is 1.27.3
forge-std is v1.17.0; CI installs Foundry v1.8.6; actions/setup-go, pnpm/action-setup and foundry-toolchain are on their latest releases
unit, lint, typecheck, build and e2e pass
notes: 2026-10-22 axe-core 4.14 makes label-content-name-mismatch (WCAG 2.5.3) a real rule; 20 privy e2e tests fail on it (profile switcher, account menu, row links, address tooltips, the status menu). @axe-core/playwright stays 4.13.0 until a task fixes those names.

2026-10-22 review fail by reviewer: pnpm 12 ignores the package.json pnpm field, so the F126 security overrides are gone: pnpm-lock.yaml has no overrides section and now resolves ws 8.18.0/8.18.3, uuid 8.3.2/9.0.1 and decode-uri-component 0.2.2 (pnpm config get overrides is undefined). Move overrides into pnpm-workspace.yaml, reinstall, and confirm the lockfile keeps them; everything else checked out.

2026-10-22 review fail by reviewer: packages/contracts/foundry.lock still pins forge-std v1.16.2 (rev bf647bd) while the submodule is v1.17.0 (f3dae6e). With Foundry 1.8.6, forge build --locked fails on the mismatch, and forge install (or the auto-install forge build runs on a clone without submodules) checks out v1.16.2 again; set lib/forge-std to v1.17.0/f3dae6e in foundry.lock. Everything else checked out: overrides apply (ws, uuid, decode-uri-component as on main), frozen install, lint, typecheck, go build/vet, outdated and CI pins are fine.

2026-10-22 review fail by reviewer: Foundry 1.8.6, which CI now installs, breaks two CI checks. (1) The ci-only symbolic check fails: Foundry 1.8 turns dynamic_test_linking on by default, which rewrites 'new X()' in tests to vm.deployCode, and halmos 0.3.3 (the latest) stops with 'Unsupported cheat code: deployCode(string,bytes)' in setUp, 0 of 3 passed; with FOUNDRY_DYNAMIC_TEST_LINKING=false all 3 pass, so set dynamic_test_linking = false in foundry.toml. (2) Backend unit tests under Anvil 1.8.6: TestRestartAfterSendingSendsNothing and TestSentSettleIsFinishedEvenIfTheWalletChanged fail with 'send settle: transaction already imported' (2 of 2 full go test runs, 3 of 30 isolated runs) and never under Anvil 1.5.1 (0 of 30, full run green); the verify ran with local Foundry 1.5.1. Everything else checked out: overrides and allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml, frozen install, lint, typecheck, forge build --locked/fmt/test on 1.8.6, go build/vet, Biome file coverage unchanged, code changes behavior-neutral, pins and SHAs match, no AI attribution.

2026-10-22 review fail by reviewer: Foundry 1.8.6, which CI now installs, fails the backend unit tests: concurrent forge script --broadcast runs (chaintest.DeployFactory in internal/address, canary, settlement, run in parallel by go test ./...) now lock packages/contracts/cache/Deploy.s.sol/31337/run-latest.json.recovery.json, and TestFactoryDeployed fails with 'another process is already modifying recovery state' (2 of 2 full go test -race runs and the unit check; 5 of 30 concurrent runs vs 0 of 30 and a green full run on 1.5.1). Serialize DeployFactory across test processes (e.g. a file lock) or give each run its own broadcast state. Everything else checked out: the reconcile holds() change is safe (await still needs this hash's receipt; nothing is booked from the send answer), the new test fails 3 of 3 without the fix on 1.8.6 and 1.5.1 and passes 20 of 20 with it, the Mine(1) lines keep the mined case honest, harness/docs-check/lint/typecheck/build/e2e/symbolic pass on 1.8.6, overrides, foundry.lock, allowBuilds, Biome and pins are right, no AI attribution.

2026-10-22 review pass by reviewer: The deploy flock is held for the whole forge script call and released on every path (defer Close runs on t.Fatal; the OS frees it on exit). With it, 40 of 40 parallel deploys pass under Foundry 1.8.6; without it, 25 of 40 fail on the recovery-file lock. The backend suite passes 3 times with -race, and forge build --locked, fmt, test and Halmos pass; parallel forge create is unaffected, and no commit has AI attribution.

proof.1: unit: pnpm outdated -r lists only @axe-core/playwright 4.13.0 -> 4.14.0 (held: axe 4.14 fails 20 privy e2e tests on label-in-name); packageManager pnpm@12.15.0; the F126 overrides sit in pnpm-workspace.yaml and ws, uuid and decode-uri-component resolve as on main
proof.2: unit: go list -m -u lists no direct update; go.mod go 1.27.3; go build and go vet pass
proof.3: unit: forge-std v1.17.0 in the submodule and foundry.lock; with Foundry v1.8.6 forge build --locked passes, forge test passes all 71 tests and the Halmos symbolic check passes 3 of 3 (dynamic_test_linking off); ci.yml Foundry v1.8.6, setup-go v7, pnpm/action-setup v6.1.0 (ea17c68), foundry-toolchain v1.9.2 (dba66c2)
proof.4: unit: unit (Go tests on Anvil/Foundry 1.8.6), lint, typecheck, build and e2e (with the privy specs) pass; TestRestartResendsAPendingSettleOnce failed before the reconcile fix; three parallel TestFactoryDeployed runs fail 4 of 30 without the deploy lock and 0 of 30 with it
